sentences.en: The driver had to manoeuvre the car carefully around the corner.
sentences.zh: 司机必须小心翼翼地操控汽车拐弯。

sentences.en: In chess, a good manoeuvre can change the course of the game.
sentences.zh: 在国际象棋中，一个好的策略可以改变整局游戏的走向。

sentences.en: The manager had to manoeuvre her way into becoming department head.
sentences.zh: 经理不得不想方设法成为部门主管。

senses.zh: 调动；演习; 谨慎而熟练的动作
